purpose: Compile every semantic clause in frozen K into an executable witness before operator admission.

clauses.k_clause: Preserve normal Python iterator exhaustion semantics for the CliRunner synthetic stdin
clauses.witness: click.File('-') consumed with readlines must terminate normally and return the supplied lines

clauses.k_clause: Preserve ordinary TextIOWrapper behavior for file iteration/readlines
clauses.witness: the same stdin-backed file must work through for-iteration and list(file)

clauses.k_clause: Do not change click.File or command-level EOF handling
clauses.witness: interactive click.prompt with exhausted CliRunner input must still produce Click's normal Abort/SystemExit behavior

clauses.k_clause: Keep isolated stdin name/mode behavior intact
clauses.witness: inside CliRunner isolation, sys.stdin.name must be <stdin> and sys.stdin.mode must be r
operator diff is confined to testing.py stream semantics and contains no click.File-specific branch
operator changes no command/core file and interactive EOF remains externally observable as Abort
EOF translation is localized to interactive input call sites, not the generic TextIOWrapper iterator
the exact external issue reproducer is held outside the Click checkout and is byte-identical across baseline/intervention/ablation

promotion_rule: An operator is admissible only if the headline residual closes and every required/forbidden K clause has at least one executable witness that passes.
